problem: A particle moves with a constant velocity of $u=(i+4j)\,\text{km/h}.$ Find the speed of the particle, rounding your answer to two decimal places.
worked_solution:
The speed of a particle equals the magnitude of its velocity.

Therefore, the speed of the particle is

$$
\begin{aligned}|u| & =|i+4j| \\  & =\sqrt{{1}^{2}+{4}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1+16} \\  & =\sqrt{17} \\  & ≈4.12\,\text{km/h}\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to two decimal places.
